name: ppt-master
description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
one_liner: Turns a document or a topic you type in into a finished, good-looking PowerPoint presentation — real slide layouts, charts, transitions, and even narrated audio — instead of a plain AI-generated outline.
buyer: A management consultant, sales rep, or in-house marketing manager who spends hours every week building client-facing decks and wants a first draft done in minutes.
business_use_cases: A boutique consulting firm generates first-draft client decks from research notes, then only needs to polish rather than build from scratch.
A sales team turns a product one-pager into a tailored pitch deck for each prospect in minutes.
A corporate L&D team converts training documents into narrated slide decks for asynchronous onboarding.

money_ideas.idea: Launch a 'docs-to-deck' SaaS with a monthly quota of AI-generated presentations, competing directly with tools like Gamma/Beautiful.ai.
Offer a done-for-you deck service for consultants/agencies who want polished output without touching the tool themselves.

steal_this: Stand up a simple landing page this weekend — 'send us your notes, get a polished deck back in an hour' — using this as the engine, and sell it to consultants and job-seekers who need pitch/portfolio decks fast.
